Welcome to the Basketball Score Explorer website. This site visualizes the distribution of home and away score combinations from your game data.

- [View the score heatmap](scores.qmd)
- Data source: `Games.csv`

## About

The score heatmap page shows which score pairs occurred during the season and how frequently they appeared.

## Files included

- `Games.csv` — game results data
- `scores.qmd` — Quarto page that renders the score heatmap
- `styles.css` — custom site styling
